title: Prep Notes, Week 5
dek: Lamar Jackson and Kyle Monangai are out; D'Andre Swift is RB11 with the Chicago backfield to himself, and Ashton Jeanty is a true Sunday decision.
author: Chef Hazy
intro_md:
Updated Fri 6:20 PM ET: Mike Evans (SF, ribs) is off the final injury report with no designation; he is WR24 for me @SEA, a WR2.

Friday's final reports are in. Fourteen fantasy players are out, nobody we play is doubtful, and sixteen are questionable. Lamar Jackson is out, so Tyler Huntley starts Sunday night @ATL, and Kyle Monangai's turf toe hands the Chicago backfield to D'Andre Swift, RB11 for me after a full Friday practice. Stefon Diggs and Quentin Johnston are out, Saquon Barkley, DeVonta Smith and Breece Hall miss again, and Michael Pittman Jr. is out multiple weeks. Rankings are for full PPR.

Cleared with no designation: Chris Olave, Jayden Daniels, Tyler Shough, Drake Maye, Jalen Hurts, Dallas Goedert, Malik Nabers, Cam Skattebo, Jeremiyah Love, Tony Pollard, Brock Bowers and Mason Taylor. The true Sunday decisions are Ashton Jeanty, Ja'Marr Chase, Tee Higgins, Terry McLaurin and Rico Dowdle; Zay Flowers waits for the 6:50 PM ET inactives Sunday night, and London's inactives drop at 8:00 AM ET. Mike Evans (ribs) has no designation and plays @SEA. Buffalo and the Rams play Monday and post designations Saturday; DJ Moore did not practice Thursday.
